name: zrndr_fill_span565_solid
description: zRndr_FillSpan565Solid fills or alpha-blends a 5:6:5 16-bit span toward a packed color.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification remains blocked: same-session refresh of python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4998a0 reports 87 unmasked mismatches with 4 relocation bytes masked, 12 trim nops, Binary Ninja body 134 bytes, and VC symbol 144 bytes. A green-scaled-before-red source probe preserved functional behavior but regressed to 89 mismatches with 11 trim nops; redAdjusted update-local spelling was byte-neutral at 87 and was reverted. Prior raw green/red delta lifetime, split green shift/mask, final-expression-order, and green-before-red contribution-order probes were byte-neutral or worse. The reviewed diff still shows arithmetic register-ordering and partial-register mask-shape drift while preserving the same 5:6:5 blend thresholds and masks.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4998a0 validates fastcall packedColor16 in ECX and blendAlpha in EDX, stack pixelCount, loading gRndr_CurrentSpanBaseAddr, alpha <= 3 no-op behavior, alpha >= 0xfc direct overwrite, and 5:6:5 per-channel alpha blending with masks 0xf800, 0x07e0, and 0x001f.

Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the green-channel blend contribution uses an AL partial-register mask in assembly; the store, masks, thresholds, and fastcall ABI are verified from assembly.
The native smoke verifies the no-op alpha threshold, partial blend output for alpha 0x80, and direct overwrite behavior for alpha 0xfc over a two-pixel span.
